title: Workflow Execution Failures Anomaly

definition.name: [n8n] Workflow Execution Failures Anomaly
definition.query: avg(last_10m):anomalies(sum:n8n.workflow.failed.count{*} by {host}.as_rate(), 'agile', 3, direction='above', interval=300, alert_window='last_10m', count_default_zero='true', seasonality='hourly') >= 1
definition.message: {{#is_alert}}Anomalous spike in workflows failures. Failure rate significantly higher than baseline.{{/is_alert}}{{#is_warning}}Workflows showing unusual failure patterns.{{/is_warning}}{{#is_recovery}}Failure rate returned to normal patterns.{{/is_recovery}}

options.escalation_message: Anomalous failure pattern persists. Immediate investigation recommended.

description: The monitor alerts when the workflow execution has an anomaly
